_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR PRICING. The server reads prices from this file and recomputes every order total itself — prices sent by the browser are ignored. Every SKU below is taken from the Truman product catalogue. Prices are in EGP piastres (100 = EGP 1.00) and were set from the Store column of the price list on 2026-10-05. Hide any product by setting in_stock to false.
